scripts.server: uv run --with fastapi --with uvicorn --with 'psycopg[binary]' --with psycopg-pool --with pydantic --with python-dotenv --with httpx --with dnspython --with inngest --with pyjwt --with email-validator uvicorn backend.app.main:app --host 0.0.0.0 --port 8000 --reload
scripts.test: uv run --with pytest --with fastapi --with 'psycopg[binary]' --with psycopg-pool --with pydantic --with python-dotenv --with httpx --with dnspython --with inngest --with pyjwt --with email-validator python -m pytest backend/tests -q
scripts.start: npm run server & npm run inngest & npm run dev
